questions.question: When the prophet Elisha returned to Gilgal, what hardship was in the land?
When the sons of the prophets tasted a stew made with wild gourds, what did they cry out to Elisha?

answers.text: There is death in the pot
The stew is far too bitter

questions.question: When the prophets' stew was spoiled, what did Elisha ask for instead of dumping the pot?
Elisha told his servant to feed twenty loaves of barley bread to a hundred men. What did the LORD say would happen?

answers.text: They would eat and have some left over
Each man would get only a small piece
The bread would last until the famine ended
